criteria.description: A first-time visitor sees a welcome (what Spec Kitty is, agenda, what to bring, install-in-session note) with Start.
criteria.evidence: WP03 review: welcome copy matches the WP prompt word for word; Start leads to the intake. WP09 quickstart step 1 PASS on the integrated app.

criteria.description: Five intake questions answered before the modules.
criteria.evidence: WP03 review: one-page intake with 5 fieldsets and legends; WP09 quickstart step 2 PASS.

criteria.description: Intake covers Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS, tablet/phone and chip x64/ARM/not sure.
criteria.evidence: intake.js ENUMS + QUESTIONS (WP01 review); chip shown only for windows/macos/linux (WP03 review, WP09 step 2).

criteria.description: Each module shows only content matching the attendee's answers.
criteria.evidence: tests/coverage.test.js rules 2-3 over 1,485 combinations (WP08 review, 0 failures); WP09 quickstart step 3 on four combinations.

criteria.description: Answers can be changed at any time and content updates immediately.
criteria.evidence: WP03 review: pre-fill and live overview; WP04 review: module page swaps Windows to macOS blocks without reload; WP09 step 4 PASS.

criteria.description: Tablet/phone or locked work laptop are told to contact the trainer right after the intake.
criteria.evidence: WP03 review: both stop banners, suggestion never setup/ready; coverage rule 1 + ready rule 5 (WP08); WP09 step 5 PASS.

criteria.description: Overview of modules with progress and a suggested next step.
criteria.evidence: WP03 review: bento overview, progress counts 4 non-optional modules, suggested-next chip; orchestrator fix hides the suggestion once all modules are done.

criteria.description: Tool-neutral explanations of the listed vocabulary terms.
criteria.evidence: WP05 review: all FR-008 terms present and accurate to research R0-03; no when conditions; tool names only as examples.

criteria.description: Matching exercise with explanations for wrong matches.
criteria.evidence: WP05 review (8 pairs with whyWrong) and WP04 review (keyboard-operable, seeded shuffle, persistence). Note: the match covers 8 of the 10 terms, per WP scope.

criteria.description: Vibe coding vs spec-driven: seven steps with outputs, work packages, worktrees, one Bright Factory line, command note.
criteria.evidence: WP05 review: seven-step table with outputs and owners, exactly one Bright Factory line, command-style block.

criteria.description: Acceptance-criterion judging exercise with explanations.
criteria.evidence: WP05 review (6 statements, each with why) and WP04 review (why always shown, tally, persistence).

criteria.description: Git install, identity and verify steps per platform.
criteria.evidence: WP07 review (cycle 2): commands checked against git-scm.com; coverage completeness rule requires >=3 git blocks with step and check for every combination (WP08).

criteria.description: Python 3.11+ install and verify per platform, with traps.
criteria.evidence: WP07 review (cycle 2): brew install python3 fix, Windows Store alias warning, uv fallback guidance; sources python.org, Microsoft Learn, winget-pkgs.

criteria.description: Chosen tool: cost model, official install link, log-in reminder.
criteria.evidence: WP06 review: one block per tool from tools.js (costs checked on official sites 2026-10-26), official links with rel=noopener, no copied commands.

criteria.description: 'Help me choose' lists supported tools with cost and lets the attendee pick.
criteria.evidence: WP06 tool-chooser block + WP04 review: picking saves answers.tool and swaps in that tool's block.

criteria.description: One agent check that works for any tool.
criteria.evidence: WP06 review: tool-neutral agent-check steps with success criteria and troubleshooting; coverage rule 1 requires it for every non-stopped combination.

criteria.description: Work-device guidance on admin rights, IT policy and blocked AI tools.
criteria.evidence: WP06 review: work-can-install note, work-locked warning, mobile warning with correct when values.

criteria.description: Optional pipx/uv head start.
criteria.evidence: WP06 review: per-OS pipx commands checked against pipx.pypa.io, verify step, uv linked.

criteria.description: Ready-check checklist.
criteria.evidence: WP08 review: 9 tailored items, rule 5 (no dead items) over 1,485 combinations; WP04 review: checklist engine; WP09 step 8 PASS.

criteria.description: Copy my setup summary, with manual-selection fallback.
criteria.evidence: WP01 summary tests; WP04 review: live summary, clipboard and selected-text fallback; WP09 step 8 and network audit (nothing sent).

criteria.description: Experience answer changes the suggested next step without locking modules.
criteria.evidence: tailor.suggestedNext unit tests (WP01); WP03 review verified all three experience values; WP09 step 6 PASS.

criteria.description: Optional 'Terminal in 5 minutes' per OS.
criteria.evidence: WP07 review: six topics, per-OS variants, optional: true; suggested first for terminal-new (WP09 step 6).

criteria.description: 'Not you? Start fresh' clears only this course's data and shows the intake.
criteria.evidence: WP01 store foreign-key test; WP02/WP03 reviews and WP09 step 10: only skcp:v1 removed, ccol:progress:v1 kept.

criteria.description: Answers and progress remembered on return.
criteria.evidence: WP09 step 9: reload and full browser relaunch with the same profile keep answers and module progress.

criteria.description: Course says the trainer demos in Claude Code and commands may differ per tool.
criteria.evidence: Welcome demo note (WP03 review) and command-style block per tool, e.g. $spec-kitty-specify for Codex (WP04 review).

negative_invariants.description: The app never clears or enumerates browser storage outside its own skcp:v1 key (NFR-003, NFR-004).
negative_invariants.evidence: grep found zero matches; store foreign-key isolation test passes (tests 33/0).

negative_invariants.description: The service worker never deletes a cache without the skcp- prefix (R-02, NFR-004).
negative_invariants.verification_command: Headless Chrome run with seeded foreign caches (onboarding-lab-v7, random-thing): activate kept both and deleted only skcp-v0.

negative_invariants.description: No request carries answers or progress, and there are no third-party hosts (NFR-005).
negative_invariants.verification_command: Quickstart step 15 network audit over intake, exercises, ready check and summary copy.
negative_invariants.evidence: 85 requests, all GET to the site's own origin, no query strings or bodies (WP09 implementation and review).
